04 / About

A technical eye, a visual point of view.

I’m Jayanth Kandala, a Computer Science student interested in how thoughtful design can make digital experiences clearer and more engaging.

I enjoy moving between structure and expression: shaping an interface, making an interaction feel intuitive, or exploring a visual direction for a story. I’m still building my practice, and I care about craft, curiosity, and learning by making.

Make it clearGive content and actions a natural order.
Make it distinctUse visual choices with a reason behind them.
Make it workBuild responsive experiences that feel considered.
Design is a way of asking better questions.

Make it clear.
